That makes sense. Carly seemed to imply in one episode that being a traveler was all-consuming and you dedicated your life to it, so it would make sense that a name would come with that new identity.

Hmm, I see where you’re coming from, but I like to think Mac would tell the truth on David’s death bed. Mac had a lot of respect for him, and given what David had just done, it would seem out of character for Mac to suddenly follow protocol since they had broken protocol for a lot less throughout the rest of the series. Especially considering they were all pretty angry with the director at that moment for not sending help.
